sources.entry: Tot - Tot is an elegant, simple way to collect & edit text. It’s your tiny text companion! ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tot/id1491071483?platform=mac)

summary.name: Tot
summary.one_liner: Tot is a simple app for collecting and editing text notes across Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, synced via iCloud.
use_cases: capture quick notes and scrappy ideas
sync notes across Mac, iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch
write and convert text to Markdown for the web
summary.what_it_does: Tot is a note and text app that lets users collect and edit text on Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch (via Tot Mini). It uses a single-window design with simple formatting controls, and supports rich or plain text with automatic translation to Markdown. Text syncs across devices through iCloud, and the app automatically backs up text regularly. It includes Shortcuts actions to store and retrieve text, keyboard shortcuts for common text operations, live word and character counts, and customizable smart bullets for checklists.
notable: Single-window design with Shortcuts support for storing and retrieving text
Tot Mini on Apple Watch syncs via iCloud
Automatic Markdown translation for web use
Redesigned for Liquid Glass with dark and light modes
caveats: Free on Mac, iPhone, and iPad, with paid premium features
Apple platforms only (Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch)
